# llms.txt - Information for AI/LLM crawlers
# https://jobhelper.novu.works

# About
NovuJobs is an AI-powered career command center and job application tracking platform by Novu.

# Features
- Kanban board for tracking job applications across stages (Wishlist, Applied, Interviewing, Offer, Accepted, Rejected)
- AI-curated job recommendations matching user resumes with Gemini 3.8 Flash
- Commute time calculations powered by Google Maps Platform
- Chrome extension for one-click job saving from LinkedIn, Indeed, and other job boards
- Google Sign-In and secure Firebase multi-tenant storage
- Local budget protections and caching ensuring zero cloud overages
- Mobile-optimized responsive design

# Pages
/                   - Dashboard with job statistics and quick actions
/kanban             - Kanban board view for managing job applications
/recommendations    - AI-curated job recommendations
/profile            - User profile, resume analysis, and Google Cloud settings
/install            - Chrome extension installation instructions
/privacy            - Privacy Policy (GDPR compliant)
/terms              - Terms of Service

# Technology Stack
- Next.js 16 (React 19)
- Firebase Authentication & Firestore
- Google Gemini 3.8 Flash & Google Maps Platform
- Zustand for state management
- Chrome Extension (Manifest V3)
